title: Novel Dynamical Systems with Finite-Time and Predefined-Time Stability for Generalized Inverse Mixed Variational Inequality Problems
summary: This paper investigates a class of generalized inverse mixed variational inequality problems (GIMVIPs), which consist in finding a vector $\overline{w}\in \R^d$ such that \[ F(\bar w)\in Ω\quad \text{and} \quad \langle h(\bar w), v-F(\bar w) \rangle + g(v)-g(F(\bar w)) \ge 0, \quad \forall v\in Ω, \] where \(h,F:\R^d\to\R^d\) are single-valued operators, \(g:Ω\to\R\cup\{+\infty\}\) is a proper function, and \(Ω\) is a closed convex set. Two novel continuous-time dynamical systems are proposed to study the finite-time and predefined-time stability of solutions to GIMVIPs in finite-dimensional…
